readerCopy.body: The next step can use an experience that once looked like nothing more than a setback. When Chiron trines the North Node, difficult experience and forward movement reinforce each other, making an old lesson newly relevant to a choice, opportunity, or responsibility. What was learned through disappointment can improve judgment without requiring the disappointment to be romanticized. Progress can include the history rather than pretending it never happened.
